data.name: Pequenas Bolhas
data.detailed_description:
What the press is saying

GeekWire: "plays like no other puzzle game" - Tim Ellis
Hardcore Gamer: "a truly enjoyable challenge" - Kirstin Swalley
Touch Arcade: "blown away with the level of depth. One of the titles from PAX I'm most excited to play when it finally comes out." - Eli Hodapp
"breathtakingly slick and creative action" - Rob Funnell


Acerca do jogo

Jogue com aglomerados esponjosos de bolhas de sabão neste hipnotizante novo jogo de enigma. Infle, misture, combine, estoure e vença centenas de jogos com objetivos superdivertidos para completar. Usando um Motor de Dinâmica Molecular, a física do jogo funciona como nenhum outro jogo. Disponível opção para daltônicos.

NOVA JOGABILIDADE INOVADORA

Encha bolhas com ar colorido para empurrar bolhas próximas usando a física lúdica de bolhas reais! Rompa as bordas entre as bolhas para misturar novas cores e criar combinações de quatro ou mais. Planeje sua estratégia para construir reações em cadeia de cascata e combinações mais longas para deslumbrantes bônus e curingas.

HORAS DE CONTEÚDOS MARAVILHOSOS

Vivencie surpresas únicas em todos os caminhos! Cada um dos mais de 170 enigmas feitos à mão exige novas estratégias de pensamento e entrelaçamento com desafios cada vez maiores. Jogue 3 modos de jogo diferentes: ENIGMAS, ARCADE E INFINITO. Tente vencer 35 conquistas bolhudas que testarão a sua habilidade.

RELAXAMENTO E ATMOSFÉRICO

Uma música ambiente relaxante se integra graciosamente com os agradáveis sons de bolhas estourando. Coloque fones de ouvido e vivencie um novo nível de circulação e atenção. Também há dicas úteis se você ficar preso.

FÍSICA DE BOLHAS DE SABÃO PARECIDA COM A VIDA REAL

Baseado na visão do artista/programador/designer Stu Denman e inspirado pelo trabalho do seu avô, um cientista do MIT, o jogo traz a beleza da natureza para a sua tela. Um "motor de dinâmica molecular" incrivelmente fluido anima centenas de bolhas a 60 FPS.

CRIATURAS CHARMOSAS

Só você pode ajudar as criaturas aquáticas que estão presas nas bolhas. Evite caranguejos e ouriços espinhosos. Além disso tem um personagem que você vai ou amar ou odiar: um curioso peixe chamado Glub que vai revelar a sua natureza como otimista ou pessimista.

MODO DALTÔNICO

Apresentando um inovador modo daltônico que fornece uma experiência de jogo autêntica e acessível sem ícones ou padrões invasivos.

reviews.review:
I had some fun with this game, mostly in the Puzzle Mode. If you can restrict yourself to the Puzzle Mode, then sure, this is a good game. But the Arcade Mode is all about completing goals with this fish doing stuff in the level as you make your moves, and the fish is just the least fun mechanic I've ever encountered in a puzzle game. I say this as someone who went to the trouble of 100%ing the game. It's a shame, because it could have easily been done better.

I'll explain: in the Arcade Mode, levels have this fish that places bubbles according to certain patterns. Sometimes it only places bubbles in the center, sometimes only in the outside, sometimes it prefers certain zones... But the only thing you get to know at the start of a level is whether the fish is placing bubbles after a given time or whether the fish is placing bubbles after every move you make. Aside from that, there's no way to know what the fish is programmed to do each level except by observing the fish's behavior, so on your first try of a level, it's sometimes a good idea to ignore the level itself and watch what the fish does. There's a tool-tip on the side that they can use to describe what the fish is going to do each level, so why not use that?

Also, you have no idea what the fish's next move is going to be, which totally screws with your ability to plan. When you have a plan, your only option is to execute on it REALLY FAST, before the fish does something to ruin it like laying a bubble that completes a match you need, or laying a bubble with a color you're out of so you can't match it to clear it, or laying a bubble that pushes a match you need AWAY... I think that some way to know what the fish is going to do next would've helped a lot.

All that said? There's some fun to be had here; the Puzzle Mode is downright inspired at times. I was making bubbles big enough to make matches, cutting things to manipulate the physics, making all kinds of paths so stars could find their friends and avoid the wicked jelly crabs... Great, clever stuff. But even then, the game doesn't let you see more than four moves ahead. I get why that's the case in Arcade Mode, but shouldn't the Puzzle Mode let you see that stuff? So that feels like another sin of the the Arcade Mode; it's really too bad they were attached to the same game.

One last complaint: it takes too much luck to get a match of fifteen or more in Infinity Mode. Those achievements should've stopped at 10+, which takes some cleverness but doesn't give the fish as much power to screw you over.
